ImageDescription.value: High-resolution view of Zurich from the Quaibrücke, downstream the Limmat river.  This view shows some of the most important landmarks in Zurich in one picture:  The towers of Fraumünster, Grossmünster and St. Peter (whose clock has Europe's largest dial).  The historic old town is on the right side of the river, and the area around the famous Bahnhofstrasse on the left.  This panorama was constructed from two exposure layers with 13 images each, so from a total of 26 individual exposures.
